answer: One concrete defense is to make every identity lock a slashable bond that only unlocks after peers grade its work across many epochs. A swarm of fake agents can tell a fable about being independent, but each must fund its own bond, so a sybil plume of a thousand accounts costs a thousand bonds, and matching copy-paste answers get caught and burned together. Rewards per identity level off like a flat mesa, so splitting into many accounts never pays more than one honest agent.
